obligations.note: The base-approved catalog fixes the auto-approve DTI limit at 40%, but head sets Policy.DTI_MAX_PERCENT to 43. The change also edits controls/mortgage/policy-params.json to 43, so the code no longer equals the approved value, and no catalog-level approval of the new value is in the packet.

The change names ticket CHG-26006, a standard ticket approved by change manager grace.kim on 2026-10-14, before review. Its components (mortgage.controls-data, mortgage.policy, mortgage.tests) cover Policy.java, policy-params.json and UnderwritingTest.java.
declan.farrell gave a code_review approval. He holds change_approver for baseline-mortgage and is a different person from the author, priya.raman.
The code_review approval names the head commit 1e93cd90, which is the only commit on the change.

run.json claims ci-runner-06 ran on the head commit, but the attached JUnit reports come from host dev-laptop-7.local and are timestamped 2026-10-23, after the review time of 2026-10-19. They cannot be this run's reports, so the required CI evidence is invalid.
The change edits controls/mortgage/policy-params.json, a protected path, and changes an approved policy value. There is no control_owner approval in the records.

Ledger entry ACR-0406 for CRD-1 covers Policy.DTI_MAX_PERCENT, and its proof premise is DTI_MAX_PERCENT = 40. The change alters that symbol, so the evidence has lapsed. No valid replacement of the same strength against the approved value exists.

summary: The change raises the auto-approve DTI ceiling from 40% to 43% in both code and the bank's policy-params file. The approved obligation catalog still fixes the limit at 40%, so CRD-1 is violated. The edit to the protected controls file has no control_owner approval, and the exhaustive CRD-1 proof in the ledger has lapsed with no valid replacement. The CI reports are also inconsistent with the claimed run: they come from a personal machine and are dated after the review time. The ticket, independent code review and approval-on-head are in order, but the change is rejected.
